sentences.en: We have yet to discover an effective remedy for cancer.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有发现有效的癌症治疗方法。

sentences.en: Hot lemon with honey is a good remedy for colds.
sentences.zh: 蜂蜜柠檬水是治疗感冒的好方法。

sentences.en: Love is a sickness full of woes, All remedies refusing.
sentences.zh: 爱情是一种充满痛苦的疾病，没有任何治疗方法可以治愈。

collocations.zh: 对…的治疗法或药物，补救
